capsuleTopic.title: Joseph
capsuleTopic.subtitle: Favored · sold · entrusted · raised · testing · reconciliation · famine · memory
capsuleTopic.orientation: Follow Joseph without reducing the story to dreams, suffering, success, or forgiveness. Watch how family, objects, speech, divine presence, power, famine, burial, descendants, and later memory change around the same person.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Follow Joseph from Rachel’s son and Jacob’s favored child through pit, house, prison, Pharaoh’s court, family testing, disclosure, famine administration, death, bones, descendants, and named or unnamed Scripture memory.
